disambiguation: It is a security gateway for AI access, not a general AI note-taking tool.
motivation: The author built it because most integrations give the assistant everything, and Kado is built around the opposite default.
problem: Existing AI integrations often grant assistants unrestricted, full read/write access to the entire vault.
summary: Security-first Model Context Protocol server that provides granular, default-deny access control for AI assistants interacting with the vault.
